name: citystore-reel
description: City Store (citystore.ma) vertical promo reel - Remotion

scripts.setup: bash scripts/setup_rhubarb.sh && node scripts/fetch_fonts.mjs && python3 scripts/sample_colors.py && python3 scripts/extract_logo.py
scripts.audio: npm run vo && npm run timeline && npm run music && npm run sfx && npm run mix
scripts.build: npm run products && npm run audio && npm run srt && npm run render:9x16 && npm run render:1x1 && npm run render:cover && npm run finalize && npm run verify
scripts.watch:audio: REEL=watch python3 scripts/process_vo_take.py && python3 reels/watch/build_timeline.py && REEL=watch python3 scripts/make_music.py && REEL=watch python3 scripts/mix_audio.py
scripts.watch:render: remotion render WatchReel9x16 out/watch/reel_9x16_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion render WatchReel1x1 out/watch/reel_1x1_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion still WatchCover out/watch/cover_1080x1920.png
scripts.watch:build: npm run watch:cutout && npm run watch:audio && REEL=watch node scripts/make_srt.mjs && npm run watch:render && REEL=watch bash scripts/finalize.sh && REEL=watch bash scripts/verify.sh
scripts.galaxy:audio: REEL=galaxy python3 scripts/process_vo_take.py && python3 reels/galaxy/build_timeline.py && REEL=galaxy python3 scripts/make_music.py && REEL=galaxy python3 scripts/mix_audio.py
scripts.galaxy:render: remotion render GalaxyReel9x16 out/galaxy/reel_9x16_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion render GalaxyReel1x1 out/galaxy/reel_1x1_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion still GalaxyCover out/galaxy/cover_1080x1920.png
scripts.galaxy:build: npm run galaxy:cutout && npm run galaxy:audio && REEL=galaxy node scripts/make_srt.mjs && npm run galaxy:render && REEL=galaxy bash scripts/finalize.sh && REEL=galaxy bash scripts/verify.sh
scripts.sony:audio: REEL=sony python3 scripts/process_vo_take.py && python3 reels/sony/build_timeline.py && REEL=sony python3 scripts/make_music.py && REEL=sony python3 scripts/mix_audio.py
scripts.sony:render: remotion render SonyReel9x16 out/sony/reel_9x16_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion render SonyReel1x1 out/sony/reel_1x1_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion still SonyCover out/sony/cover_1080x1920.png
scripts.sony:build: npm run sony:cutout && npm run sony:audio && REEL=sony node scripts/make_srt.mjs && npm run sony:render && REEL=sony bash scripts/finalize.sh && REEL=sony bash scripts/verify.sh
